chunk_map.heading: New interviews make the insight pages sharper, not longer

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6 "The old claims and the new ones meet." closest: antecedents "pages it already keeps" and "new interviews" are both named in L4 inside the same chunk; L8 "A claim the agent dropped" resolves to L6 "cut". Harm (unresolved referent on a projected slide) absent.
closest L4 "the team's insight pages" - names its subject in-sentence, points at no other file by position; grep for "lecture|module|earlier|opening" in body -> 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no "the X you did/saw/caught" backward references in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no demo or guess beat; has_prompt_blocks false, no guess-cue

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 "an agent keeping the team's insight pages does not add a new section. It reads the pages it already keeps first, then the new material, then rewrites." is a self-carrying claim; the one-chunk deck is not a wait-state.
header L1 "New interviews make the insight pages sharper, not longer" is borne out by L4 (rewrite instead of add), L6 (claims meet, weak ones cut), L8 (cuts are visible); nothing contradicts it.

closest L4 "does not add a new section. It reads... then rewrites." - one negation then a sequence, not "Not X. Not Y. Z."; "reads..., then..., then rewrites" is an ordered process, no empty leg; no superlatives, no number+retraction, no abstraction stacks. grep body for "most|best|one of the" -> 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep dialect terms (forcing function|compendium|beat|mood|surface|firing) over body L1-9 -> 0 hits; "insight pages", "claim", "pain point" are product-team vocabulary the APT101 room uses.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: bold count in body L1-9: grep -c "\*\*" -> 0; budget <=1 met.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: single chunk carries `<!--slide:new-sources-sharpen-old-->` id and sits in a slide file the deck composes; no phase-less prose section. Composed-deck render not run by this judge; structural check only.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers or ordinal numbering in the file

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js | grep new-sources-sharpen -> no output, no hit; body grep (below|above|further down|see below) -> 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links (signals.has_urls false; no [T](path) includes)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/new-sources-sharpen-old.md -> "every slide is within limits", oversized 0; one chunk, 3 paragraphs, 0 bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: lecture-style claim header L1 "New interviews make the insight pages sharper, not longer" - a declarative, as lecture headings require; file is a slide file, not an exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest L8 "A claim the agent dropped is a decision someone on the team should see." - adds a new move (surface the cuts for review) not held by L4/L6, so not doctrine restatement; L6 last sentence is the mechanism, not a kicker restating the header. No self-referential design commentary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: maintainer STATUS L12 says the header was lifted from the body's former closing line (squint build). Cover-body test: header promises sharper-not-longer; L4 rewrite-not-add, L6 meeting and cutting, L8 visible cuts all answer it; no bullet answers an old header.
